correctness.rationale: The physical-time stopped singleton law is exactly 1+Bin(n-1,m/(exp(m)-1)) conditional on the last exponential first-arrival m. The m=log n+O(1) mean and variance are both (log n)exp(-(m-log n))+O(1); a uniform Berry-Esseen bound and tight Gumbel maximal-first-arrival time give the joint independent normal/Gumbel limit. The merged exponential clocks yield E(M_n-T_n/n)^2=H_n/n, making the random centering error o_p(sqrt(log n)). Independent rational calculations for n=2..10 check 90 identities without proving the limit.
